**Overview:** This interactive model is a calibrated fast surrogate of the Danish National Transport Model (**LTM 2.3**, Rich 2022), rebased to 2023 using Danish National Travel Survey (**TU 0624v1**), **TERESA 6.21** values of time, **TØE 2.2** vehicle operating costs, and distance-dependent public transport fare profiles (Argyros, Jensen & Rich, 2026; Rich & Fox, 2024). The model reverse-engineers LTM 2.3 from its elasticities: its response parameters are calibrated so that it reproduces LTM's elasticities. Wherever LTM's structure and coefficients are known, they are imposed rather than calibrated, and the model is rebased to the 2023 travel pattern. The calibrated parameters are reduced-form and are not LTM's own. The calculator is available in Danish and English; switch language in the app header.

- **100% browser-based:** All calibration, scenario evaluation, and rule-of-half distributional welfare calculations run locally in your browser via `engine2.js`.
- **Custom workbooks:** You can save scenarios locally or upload a modified `.xlsx` input workbook directly inside the interface to recalibrate in ~8 seconds.
